description: Parallelize outbox delivery using Promise.all with concurrency limiting to eliminate sequential processing bottleneck
approach: Replace sequential for-of loop with parallel Promise.all execution using p-limit for concurrency control. This allows multiple outbox items to be delivered simultaneously while preventing overwhelming downstream services. With 10 concurrent deliveries, 100 items at 100ms each reduces from 10 seconds to ~1 second.

tasks.title: Refactor flushOutboxDeliveryQueue to use parallel execution
tasks.description: Replace sequential for-of loop with Promise.all and p-limit for parallel outbox delivery with controlled concurrency

modification_points.description: Replace sequential loop with parallel Promise.all execution

implementation: Add import at top of file: import pLimit from 'p-limit'
Create concurrency limiter with configurable limit: const limit = pLimit(this.configService.config.pipeline.outboxDeliveryConcurrency ?? 10)

Replace for-of loop with parallel execution: const deliveryPromises = batch.map(([outboxId, payload]) => limit(() => this.deliverOutboxFromQueue(outboxId, payload).catch(err => { this.logger.warn({ err, outboxId }, 'Outbox delivery failed'); return null; })))
Execute all in parallel: await Promise.all(deliveryPromises)
Ensure individual failures don't block other deliveries
